candidate_release.policy: One package, two channels: latest remains compatible v1; next is planned for deliberately approved v2 milestone previews. Historical next remains 1.0.0-next.0 until first authorized publication. No preview has been published by this setup.
candidate_release.default_contract: Agreed v2 preview default: modern root/pure/styles/types, image zoom with HD, native dialog and accessible triggers, a slim state-based controller, structural CSS without gallery themes. Explicit compat preserves the v1 API/browser/style contract. Implemented locally, not published; see docs/modern-preset.md.
candidate_release.local_verification: Separate from the original audit: packed modern/compat consumer checks and Chromium/WebKit desktop/mobile regression tests pass against the PR #310 base, including HD fallback, reduced motion, keyboard focus and teardown. Gallery benchmarks remain within that base's layout/style tolerances, retaining 24 layouts for five open/close cycles. Installed Firefox could not launch its profile. Historical minimum browsers, physical devices and original external reproductions remain unverified. No per-item fix version, published availability or closure gate changes. Modern includes modal rendering; custom content and gallery/gestures remain explicit compositions with matching CSS.
prerequisites: Review modern preset migration contract and candidate API readiness for the milestone
Configure protected npm-next environment with required reviewers and main-only deployments
Add preview-release.yml/npm-next npm trusted publisher without replacing release.yml
Complete non-publishing checks and authorize an unused increasing milestone version
candidate_release.closure_policy: Preview publication permits testing invitations only. Candidate-dependent closure requires supported stable API/CSS/docs and original-case verification, plus any per-item scope decision.

method: Read-only GitHub inventory, issue discussions, PR diffs/discussions, release and npm metadata, tagged 1.1.2 implementation, current source and regression tests. Existing tests inspected, not executed in this checkout; no original external reproductions or real-device validation performed. No GitHub writes.

placeholders.{V1_VERSION}: Actual published v1 version (currently latest 1.1.2; proposed 1.2.0 is not yet published).
placeholders.{CANDIDATE_RELEASE}: Actual supported stable version exposing candidate APIs for closure drafts; a 2.0.0-next.N preview permits testing, not stable closure.

placeholders.{PREVIEW_VERSION}: Actual published 2.0.0-next.N, verified in the registry; never infer availability from this setup.
placeholders.{PREVIEW_DOCS_URL}: Verified milestone documentation URL, including browser floor, CSS, API setup and known limitations.
